title: Financial Analyst
description:
We’re helping an international finance and M&A consultancy find a Financial Analyst to support transaction advisory, fundraising, and strategic finance projects for high-growth startups and scaleups.

You’ll build sophisticated financial models, prepare investor and board materials, and support valuation and deal execution across software and deeptech companies. This is a hands‑on, high‑accountability role where flawless work is non‑negotiable — your analyses will directly inform key decisions and client strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is a wizard with numbers , detail‑obsessed yet commercially minded, and capable of seeing both the story and strategy behind the spreadsheets .

Part time to start, 24 hours/week (with potential to transition to full time)
Schedule: CET working hours
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Compensation: $1440-$2200 (based on a 24‑hour workweek, depending on level of experience); $2400-$3680 for full time

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Modelling (Forecast & Scenario Analysis)
    Build fully linked 3‑statement financial models with sensitivities and scenarios (base, downside, management).
    Create cash flow forecasts, liquidity bridges, and valuation‑ready modules (DCF, comps, transaction comps).

  • Historical Restatement & Data Hygiene
    Reconcile and clean raw data (GL exports, bank data, SaaS metrics) into analysis‑ready formats.
    Maintain version control, audit trails, and traceability from trial balance to model.

  • Reporting Templates & Automation
    Design board and investor reporting templates, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis frameworks.
    Build SaaS metrics (ARR/MRR bridges, churn, LTV/CAC, NRR) and recurring revenue templates.

  • Transaction Support (Model‑Led)
    Produce deal‑ready schedules for buy‑side and sell‑side engagements (QofE, NWC, closing adjustments).
    Translate model outputs into charts and visuals for investment memorandums and management presentations.

  • Quality Assurance & Standards
    Follow strict QA processes (FAST/SMART methodology).
    Double‑check every formula, input, and output — your work must be flawless .
    Ensure transparency through consistent assumptions pages, error checks, and version logs.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in M&A, Transaction Services, or FP&A , ideally from a Tier 1 investment bank or M&A boutique .

    • Candidates with more years of experience will also be considered if they remain flexible and open to new approaches.

  • Strong experience working with software companies ; exposure to deeptech (e.g., chipmakers) is a plus.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (array formulas, Power Query, dynamic formulas, structured refs).

  • Excellent grasp of valuation and deal mechanics (NWC, closing adjustments, leakage, earn‑outs).

  • Ability to turn messy data into clear historicals and models — quickly and accurately.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills — able to explain the story behind the numbers.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and ability to self‑check work before submission.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience preparing materials for investment memorandums (IMs).

  • Familiarity with CAPEX modelling and debt structuring.

  • Previous experience in software or SaaS transactions ; exposure to deeptech deals a bonus.

How Our Client Works

  • Theyown the numbers — every figure must be backed by logic, traceability, and quality assurance.

  • Theybalance precision with practicality — models should be easy to hand over and fast to update.

  • Theytranslate numbers into narratives — this role will eventually expand into creating investment memorandums where financial insights tell the story.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview

  2. Finance Case + bonus assignment

  3. Second Interview

  4. Valuation Case Test

  5. Final Interview

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

description:

Principais atividades:

  1. Planejamento e Organização do Corte
    • Organizar a programação de corte de acordo com a demanda de produção.
    • Definir os materiais e insumos necessários para cada lote de produção.
    • Planejar a sequência de cortes, levando em consideração a otimização do uso de tecido e o aproveitamento máximo do material disponível.
  2. Gestão de Equipe
    • Supervisionar a equipe de corte, garantindo que todos os colaboradores cumpram os padrões e procedimentos estabelecidos.
    • Treinar novos colaboradores e promover o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe.
    • Realizar a gestão de turnos, escalas e garantir a disciplina e motivação da equipe.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Garantir que os cortes sejam realizados com precisão, seguindo os moldes e especificações do design.
    • Identificar e corrigir problemas de qualidade no corte, como falhas nos moldes ou irregularidades no tecido.
    • Realizar inspeções regulares para verificar a conformidade com as normas de qualidade estabelecidas pela empresa.
  4. Acompanhamento de Produção
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção e verificar se o cronograma de corte está sendo cumprido.
    • Resolver eventuais problemas que possam surgir durante o processo, como falta de material, erro no corte, ou necessidade de ajustes no molde.
    • Realizar a comunicação constante com outros setores, como modelagem, produção e acabamento, para garantir a fluidez do processo.
  5. Gestão de Materiais e Recursos
    • Controlar o estoque de tecidos, garantir o uso adequado dos materiais e evitar desperdícios.
    • Acompanhar a manutenção e conservação das máquinas de corte.
    • Identificar a necessidade de reposição de materiais e insumos e realizar os pedidos de reposição.
  6. Relatórios e Acompanhamento de Resultados
    • Gerar relatórios periódicos sobre a produtividade, desperdícios e eficiência do processo de corte.
    • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e sugerir melhorias para otimização do processo.
    • Garantir que os custos com o processo de corte estejam dentro do orçamento estabelecido.
  7. Segurança e Normas
    • Garantir que os procedimentos de segurança sejam seguidos, minimizando riscos de acidentes durante o processo de corte.
    • Cumprir com as normas ambientais, de saúde e segurança no trabalho, implementando ações de prevenção de acidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  1. Ensino médio completo.
  2. Liderança e capacidade de gerenciamento de equipes;
  3. Conhecimento técnico sobre o processo de corte, tipos de tecidos e materiais.
  4. Habilidade para trabalhar com sistemas de controle de produção e relatórios.
  5. Atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de solucionar problemas rapidamente.
  6. Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com outros departamentos.

title: Técnico de Engenharia Clínica
description:
Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica

O Técnico de Engenharia Clínica é o profissional técnico responsável por assegurar o funcionamento contínuo, seguro e eficaz do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele executa manutenções preventivas, corretivas, calibrações e ensaios, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para o atendimento ao paciente, em conformidade com as normas técnicas e os procedimentos internos. Sua atuação é fundamental para a segurança do paciente e a eficiência operacional da instituição de saúde.

  • Execução de Manutenções e Intervenções Técnicas: Realizar manutenções corretivas nos equipamentos médico-hospitalares, desde a abertura do chamado até a identificação da falha e a intervenção técnica, visando restaurar todas as funcionalidades e retomar a operação de forma segura. Executar manutenções planejadas/programadas (preventivas e preditivas), utilizando padrões e simuladores adequados, para garantir que os equipamentos estejam sempre aptos para uso seguro, com laudos e certificados válidos. Realizar calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica nos equipamentos, seguindo os procedimentos e normas técnicas aplicáveis, para assegurar a precisão e a segurança dos dispositivos.
  • Gestão de Equipamentos e Controle Patrimonial: Realizar o controle e rastreio de equipamentos por meio de rondas diárias, verificando o estado geral, a localização e a condição de uso, para garantir sua conservação e disponibilidade. Acompanhar o recebimento de novos equipamentos e insumos, conferindo notas fiscais e a contagem dos produtos, e testando os equipamentos para verificar sua aptidão para o uso. Preservar e zelar pelos equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, mantendo-os organizados, limpos e conservados, e solicitando novas ferramentas ao supervisor quando necessário, demonstrando cuidado com o patrimônio da empresa.
  • Documentação e Registro no Sistema: Alimentar o sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), realizando a abertura de Ordens de Serviço (OS) e preenchendo detalhadamente as ações executadas, peças utilizadas e observações, para garantir um histórico preciso e completo do equipamento. Assegurar a correta emissão de laudos e certificados de acordo com as normativas vigentes, após a execução das manutenções e calibrações.
  • Acompanhamento e Suporte: Manter o supervisor imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e os desafios encontrados, buscando soluções e alinhando as atividades diariamente. Acompanhar as atividades de serviços realizados por terceiros dentro da unidade, por meio da análise de ordens de serviço externas, para garantir o registro e histórico completo dos equipamentos. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo que venham a ser delegadas pelo supervisor de engenharia clínica.
  • Relacionamento e Otimização: Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações conforme a necessidade do cliente, através do contato com fornecedores, com o objetivo de apoiar a ampliação dos serviços e soluções oferecidas.

description:
Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em FSO, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

#TAXFSO

Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida no escritório de São Paulo/ Rio de Janeiro/ Porto Alegre...

hybrid

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa Gerente de Tributos você será parte da área de Tax com foco na indústria financeira, atuando em consultoria tributária, auxiliando as empresas em projetos de compliance e consultoria em impostos diretos (CSLL e IRPJ) para bancos e seguradoras, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Liderar equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos e exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação do imposto diferido e respectivas projeções de acordo com as normas ASC 740 e IAS 12, bem como Tax Provision e reconciliação da alíquota efetiva;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação da apuração do imposto de renda e contribuição social seguindo as normas e legislações aplicáveis;
  • Realizar pesquisas e responder as consultas tributárias de clientes;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de trabalho produtivos com os funcionários de clientes e avaliar sua satisfação;
  • Supervisionar o trabalho de campo diário, informar aos supervisores a situação do trabalho e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Contribuir com ideias/opiniões para as equipes de impostos e ouvir/ser receptivo/a ao ponto de vista de outros membros da equipe;
  • Ter um entendimento das linhas de serviço da EY e buscar/incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços da empresa.
Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – lucro real e lucro presumido) e na preparação e revisão de ECF e ECD;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Habilidade avançada na comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade no trabalho em equipe e liderança.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, compliance e planejamento Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.
Quem somos:

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres do Brasil e, a 2a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

title: Especialista de Dados - Yield Management
description:
Especialista de Dados - Yield Management

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Buscamos um(a) Especialista de Dados com formação em Ciência de Dados e experiência em soluções de Yield Management. Esta é uma posição estratégica para quem deseja aplicar técnicas avançadas de otimização e modelos preditivos para maximizar nossas receitas e margens de lucro. Se você é movido(a) por transformar grandes volumes de dados em decisões complexas, seu lugar é aqui!

O profissional será responsável por definir e desenvolver métodos de Ciência de Dados para otimização de receita, incluindo:

  • Desenvolvimento de Modelos Preditivos e de Otimização: Criar, implementar e gerenciar modelos de Machine Learning e otimização para previsão de demanda e gestão de capacidade (Yield Management).
  • Análise de Dados: Realizar análises exploratórias e interfacear com o negócio para identificar padrões de compra, oportunidades de otimização de receita e o impacto das decisões de preços e disponibilidade.
  • Governança e Pipeline de Dados: Garantir a qualidade e o fluxo dos dados necessários para os modelos, atuando próximo(a) aos times de Engenharia de Dados.
  • Cultura Orientada a Dados: Atuar como um(a) embaixador(a) técnico(a) e consultivo(a), traduzindo insights complexos em recomendações de negócio claras para a liderança e áreas parceiras (Comercial, Marketing e Operações).

O que buscamos na sua bagagem:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida na área de Yield Management, Revenue Management ou Pricing/Precificação Dinâmica, preferencialmente em setores com restrição de capacidade (ex: aviação, hotelaria, transporte, mídia digital, varejo ou e-commerce com alta variabilidade).
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação para Ciência de Dados (Python ou R) e experiência com bibliotecas de Machine Learning (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experiência avançada em consultas e tratamentos de grandes volumes de dados utilizando SQL.
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de modelos estatísticos e matemáticos avançados para otimização (Programação Linear, Otimização Dinâmica, Modelos de Séries Temporais).
  • Habilidade para construir e comunicar narrativas orientadas a dados, transformando análises complexas em estratégias de negócio.
  • Experiência com plataformas de Big Data e Cloud Computing (GCP).
  • Experiência em modelos causais ou experimentação (A/B testing) aplicados a preços.
  • Para sua saúde e de seus dependentes – Plano de Saúde e Odontológico | Sulamérica;
  • Benefício Farmácia: até 40% de desconto em medicamentos;
  • Pacote de alimentação: VA/VR/Lanche todos os dias/Estações para um pit stop durante o dia;
  • Pensando na sua saúde física e mental: GymPass / Total Pass /Seguro de Vida
  • Para seu desenvolvimento: descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras;

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Join to apply for the Chief Operating Officer (COO) role at InPlanet

Join to apply for the Chief Operating Officer (COO) role at InPlanet

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Direct message the job poster from InPlanet

About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany Brazil and the US with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.

Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast.

Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people experience the interview process with us.

Check out our Culture page here

About The Role

Informative Video by Matyas

Hybrid, with travel in Brazil

Language Skills: Must: Portuguese, English (fluent)

Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We are searching for a seasoned, strategic, commercial, and hands-on COO to lead and shape our go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors and evolve our operational backbone. In this role, you’ll oversee our entire value chain - from mineral inputs and field operations to our internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

This is a rare opportunity to refine product-market fit , identify scalable customer use cases, lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling in one of the world’s most promising carbon removal approaches. On the operational front, you will work closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations , who leads the charge on regional management, farmer acquisition, and the logistical execution of rock powder spreading across Brazil. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our VP of Science , ensuring that our field strategy is aligned with our scientific standards, operational goals, and long-term climate impact targets - building a delivery system that is not only efficient, but deeply trusted by our farming partners.

As a core strategic and visionary player, you’ll work cross-functionally to ensure our product offering is differentiated and delivers real agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements. You’ll be responsible for orchestrating our 1-100 scale-up journey : evolving early pilots into robust, repeatable, and high-impact operations at national scale.

We’re at a tipping point of scale, with growing complexity across teams, partners, and international ecosystems. The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , ideally in Brazilian agribusiness , and can bridge execution with innovation.

You will report directly to the CEO and be a critical member of our Senior Leadership Team alongside our CFO. You’ll directly lead a large and growing team, including:

  • Head of Operations and all project deployment teams including Supply and Regional Managers
  • Our Science team, in close partnership with the VP of Science
  • Collaboration with Carbon, and Technology teams
  • Strategic collaboration with our Chief Impact Officer, and commercial partners

You’ll play a central role in aligning science, fieldwork, and operations , ensuring we stay ahead in the rapidly evolving climate and carbon removal landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations

  • You’ll help define and scale a novel carbon removal product - taking it from early traction to being a key player in agriculture and mining. This is a 1-100 leadership role, demanding bold strategy, deep market insight, and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil, with scalability in mind.
  • Translate InPlanet’s carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement through operational KPIs, systemisation, and performance data.

Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership

  • You’ll drive go-to-market strategies that bring breakthrough mineral products into entrenched agricultural systems, building the trust and partnerships needed for national adoption. Commercial creativity and strategic grit will be essential.
  • Build strategic partnerships with input suppliers, logistics providers, agricultural service firms, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder - from mine to farm.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance with carbon standards, farmer requirements, and regulatory frameworks.

Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment

  • Collaborate with Science, Carbon, and Technology teams to ensure smooth integration of R&D, field trials, and data flows.
  • You’ll bridge science and market, ensuring our product not only works in trials but wins in the real world. Field feedback will shape product evolution and create operational systems that scale with credibility and speed.
  • Support the legal team to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.

Team & Culture Building

  • You’ll build a leadership culture that’s entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable - turning high performers into high-impact owners. Your teams will know not just what to do, but why it matters.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You’ve scaled something from messy beginnings to market success - ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic - able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change
  • Competitive Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner
  • Home Office Budget
  • Hybrid Remote: ideally around Sao Paulo
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 4-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with VP of People
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • 1-2 more 1:1 interviews with core leaders
  • Panel with 4+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Our mission is to reinvent the way companies manage their open source information systems - on public clouds and in their own data centers. To achieve that we are building a new community around Python opscode for open source applications, running on Kubernetes. We want to move all of Canonical and Ubuntu IS onto this new open source codebase. We are confident that we can dramatically improve the experience of running complex business operations - and then we can help our customers embrace those new techniques and products. Traditionally, IS is an inward-facing operation. We would like to transform our IS team into an extension of the product engineering capability at Canonical. Our internal workloads are in many cases the same open source workloads that our customers want to operate. This team will productize those workloads for real-time automated operations on Kubernetes. This role is ideal for software engineers who enjoy Python, have a passion for distributed systems, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers. It is a role that requires rigor in both code and customer interactions. Our engineers are technically astute open source enthusiasts who are excited about cloud computing and are ready to join a global team charged with delivering world class services to our customers.

title: Software Engineer (Python/Linux/Packaging)
description:
Overview

Role: Software Engineer (Python/Linux/Packaging) at Canonical. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks.

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.

Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.

And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.


O time deInteraction Platform:

O time de Interaction Platform tem o propósito de facilitar o desenvolvimento de experiências multiplataforma com alta qualidade e eficiência, reduzindo os custos e o tempo que levamos para evoluir os produtos e melhorar a experiência de nossos(as) clientes.

Nossa responsabilidade é construir plataformas (Ex: mobile, web, terminais, conversacionais) e os padrões de experiência globais através do design system, viabilizando a criação de funcionalidades de forma única, padronizada e com mais agilidade, permitindo que os demais times da Stone consigam evoluir as soluções de forma eficiente e evitando a necessidade de aumentar nossos custos de operação ao desenvolver inúmeras vezes uma mesma aplicação para atender diferentes consumidores.

Como é ser uma pessoa Software Engineer Mobile Sr.

Você terá um papel de grande influência técnica no time, com a missão de compartilhar conhecimentos em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, familiarizado(a) com testes unitários, automatizados, e oferecendo suporte às pessoas desenvolvedoras do time.

Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento, que irá apoiar na evolução da régua técnica do time, com atuação "hands on" onde precisará mergulhar no código e se aproximar bastante das soluções técnicas, atuará no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e melhoria do contexto de plataforma mobile na Stone.

Atuará de forma "cross" em grandes projetos junto ao time de Interaction Platform, ajudando a realizar o movimento de plataformização na companhia, além da adoção de boas práticas no desenvolvimento de mobile.

O que esperamos de você:
  • Ter interesse em trabalhar com adoção de novas tecnologias e aprender mais sobre KMP;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Android, incluindo Kotlin e Jetpack Compose;
  • Experiência em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, adotando padrões de codificação consistentes e bem documentados;
  • Experiência em investigação, troubleshooting e depuração de sistemas.
  • Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful, serviços em nuvem (por exemplo, Firebase), armazenamento local e remoto de dados, autenticação e notificações push;
  • Conhecimentos sobre estrutura de CI/CD, pipeline automatizado;
  • Conhecimentos de arquitetura de módulos e componentização;
  • Conhecimentos sobre Testes unitários, testes de integração, testes funcionais e testes de snapshots, utilizando ferramentas como JUnit, Espresso, Mockito, XCTest, Snapshot Testing, entre outras;
  • Publicação de apps (Play Store e/ou App Store);
  • Ferramentas de métricas e marketing (e.g. Firebase, Google Analytics, Amplitude);
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum ou Kanban.
O que aumenta as suas chances:
  • Conhecimentos em KMP - Kotlin Multiplataforma
  • Familiaridade com gerenciadores de dependência (CocoaPods, Carthage, SPM), Fastlane;
  • Experiência em Android Studio e Gradle;
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento com React Native;
  • Contribuição em projetos Open Source;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Design System com compreensão dos princípios de design systems, incluindo componentização, padronização de UI/UX, uso de bibliotecas de componentes, diretrizes de design e padrões de interface;
  • Experiência com produtos digitais financeiros e/ou apps de larga escala;

Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
At Maersk Supply Service, crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator who values openness, collaboration, and trust, and who wants to make a real impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues.

Who are we?

At MSS, we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team that cares about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll join a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration and respect. We offer:

  • A flexible, energised work environment where ideas are valued.
  • A culture that celebrates diversity and teamwork—“we” comes before “I”.
  • The opportunity to shape the future of our operations and support the growth of new seafarers through our Cadet Programme.

This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection. As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What you’ll do

Your mission is simple yet powerful: attract and engage the best maritime talent while ensuring our offshore colleagues feel valued and supported .

You’ll lead initiatives that go beyond filling positions—creating meaningful connections and building trust with candidates and stakeholders. From crafting employer branding to managing end-to-end recruitment, you’ll ensure every interaction reflects our values.

Your key responsibilities will include:
  • Drive talent attraction strategies aligned with business goals.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of skilled professionals for offshore roles.
  • Lead the Cadet Programme, supporting the next generation of seafarers.
  • Act as a trusted partner to hiring managers, providing insights and guidance.
  • Champion diversity and inclusion in all recruitment activities and find the candidate with the cultural fit to the company.
  • Continuously improve processes to enhance candidate experience and efficiency.
  • Coordinate offshore recruitment, ensuring compliance with maritime regulations (MLC, STCW, NR-30, Petrobras).
  • Plan and conduct recruitment for key maritime positions: Captain, Chief Officer, Deck Officer, Chief Engineer, 2nd Engineer Officer, Electrician/ETO, Able Seafarers and Motormen, Cooks and Stewards, etc.
  • Monitor KPIs, report results, and propose improvements.
  • Ensure that candidate records, certifications, and technical documentation are updated and accurate.
  • Support audits and collaborate with Payroll, Training & Compliance, and Vessel Operations.
  • Manage onboarding/offboarding and participate in the Crewing Duty Phone rotation.

Operational excellence will underpin your work—maintaining accurate candidate data, ensuring compliance with maritime regulations, and collaborating across HR, Payroll, Training, and Vessel Operations teams. You’ll also contribute to shaping the future of our talent strategy through innovative ideas and quality-driven initiatives.

Who you are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry and enjoy building trusted relationships, and you recognize the game‑changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, HR, or related field.
  • 5+ years’ experience in offshore recruitment.
  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Knowledge of maritime regulations (MLC, STCW, NR-30, NORMAM).
  • Proven previous experience conducting recruitment processes for maritime positions.
  • Skilled in recruitment platforms and advanced Excel.
  • Strategic mindset, strong networking skills, and ability to work independently.
  • Passion for the maritime industry and commitment to diversity and inclusion.
  • Strong decision‑making, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience in lean organisations and proactive process improvement.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast‑paced environments.
How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 30 November 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

title: Sr. HSE Operations Engineer
description:
Employer company TotalEnergies EP Brasil Ltda

Context & Environment

O Brasil é um país altamente regulado, com exigências rigorosas de SSMS e necessidade de demonstração de gestão de riscos às autoridades como pré-requisito obrigatório para qualquer operação. A TotalEnergies EP Brasil é uma afilial estratégica para o Grupo, em fase de crescimento (200 mil bpd em participação do Grupo até 2025). A excelência na gestão de riscos operacionais contribui para a expansão do portfólio operado e para o aumento da influência sobre os parceiros responsáveis por ativos estratégicos operados por terceiros (OBOs). A excelência em SSMS, Segurança e Integridade garante a sustentabilidade da reputação da TotalEnergies no Brasil, ao mesmo tempo em que preserva a vida de todos os envolvidos.

Realizar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios do OneMAESTRO, visando preservar o meio ambiente e os recursos, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficiência energética e descarbonização dos ativos da empresa.

  • Participar de estudos de perigos e avaliações de riscos para garantir a execução segura dos programas operacionais.
  • Aconselhar e aprimorar o reconhecimento de perigos e o controle de riscos nas mudanças de gestão.
  • Participar diretamente na implementação dos Programas de Segurança da TotalEnergies EP Brasil.
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões de planejamento e coordenação das atividades diárias, reuniões semanais e de pré-turno “toolbox”.
  • Promover e incentivar o conceito de “Visita de Campo Gerencia em Conjunto” (Management Joint Safety Tour/Boots on the Ground).
  • Garantir, por meio de auditorias periódicas, que o sistema de Permissão de Trabalho (PTW) dos contratados esteja sendo gerenciado e executado de forma segura e correta.
  • Dar assistência, aconselhar e aprimorar as análises de causa raiz de incidentes e incidentes com Alto Potencial.
  • Participar ativamente da elaboração das “Análises de Segurança das Atividades” dos contratados relacionadas à execução das atividades.
  • Garantir a participação ativa na organização de reuniões de segurança pré-trabalho, com atenção especial para:
  • preparação de operações de içamento.
  • prevenção de queda de objetos.
  • prevenção de lesões nas mãos.
  • operações simultâneas.
  • operações críticas.
Auxiliar e aconselhar para garantir os prazos e acuidade dos relatórios de eventos, incidentes, acidentes e anomalias. Garantir o monitoramento da performance de HSE e benchmarking relacionados os KPIs atualizados, conhecidos e acompanhados. Auxiliar e aconselhar no aprimoramento da competência e treinamento das equipes em HSE (empresa e contratados). Garantir os prazos e acuidade ao reportar os eventos de HSE no sistema OneSynergi. Fornecer treinamentos específicos de HSE no campo, conforme necessário, garantindo a inclusão de toda a supervisão dos contratados. Verificar a aplicação da política de HSE e dos documentos de referência relacionados, incluindo os procedimentos da TotalEnergies EP Brasil e as Regras de HSE do Grupo TotalEnergies. Desenvolver Documentos de Integração com Contratados (Bridging Documents) e garantir que sejam compreendidos, relevantes e utilizados nas atividades de execução dos programas. Auxiliar e aconselhar o Gerente de Operações HSE. Auxiliar, aconselhar e aprimorar os meios de identificação de perigos e controle de riscos em operações simultâneas (SIMOPS) e/ou situações degradadas. Dar suporte no gerenciamento e na comunicação de forma eficaz ao pessoal de campo sobre ações corretivas relacionadas a acidentes, inspeções, auditorias e revisões. Realizar auditorias e inspeções para garantir o devido alinhamento com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE da TotalEnergies e com o OneMAESTRO. Responsabilidades:
  • Aconselhar e auxiliar o Gerente de Operações HSE na aplicação da política de HSE e na execução eficaz dos programas de trabalho definidos.
  • Comunicar e implementar os programas de HSE em instalações industriais.
  • Participar ativamente da metodologia de melhoria de processos.
  • Contribuir para a disseminação da filosofia de HSE e para o treinamento do pessoal operacional.
  • Manter uma imagem profissional, ações e expertise técnica em todos os momentos.
  • Formação superior em HSE (por exemplo: Engenharia de Segurança, Engenharia Ambiental, Higiene Ocupacional).
  • Experiência na área de SSMS em atividades de E&P em Instalações de Produção Offshore e/ou Unidades de Perfuração.

description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go‑to‑market teams—as well as directly with top‑tier Private Equity firms and enterprise‑scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high‑quality technical solutions.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go‑to‑market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype.

  • You have 5+ years of full‑stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE.
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required.
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team.
  • Prepare and manage a health- & safety plan.
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments.
Your profile
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Installation Analysis discipline within McDermott. The role solves complex problems, utilizes discipline-specific knowledge, and impacts customer, operational, project, or service activities across the installation team and related groups.

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed design as per design basis, project specifications, codes, and standards.

  • Provide engineering support onboard installation vessels offshore.
  • Be fully familiar with the project scope, specifications, schedule, and inter‑discipline requirements, raising concerns early and taking appropriate actions.
  • Identify scope changes and promptly raise change notifications and provide supporting documentation and estimates.
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash‑free designs.
  • Maintain cooperation with other engineering disciplines, planning, fabrication, marine, and project management teams.
  • Document substantive communications and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer.
  • Assist in preparing bid proposal estimates, including technical query reviews and work‑hour estimates.
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information and maintain preferred McDermott procedures.
  • Prepare discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications.
  • Participate in finalizing deliverable lists, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity.
  • Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys as required.
  • Provide technical direction and review of designers producing Construction/Installation Support Engineering products.
  • Assist procurement personnel in producing discipline equipment, materials, and services.
  • Assist in updating weight reports based on vendor information.
  • Check engineering performed by others within the discipline.
  • Perform design verification through single‑discipline and inter‑discipline checks (IDC).
  • Provide technical support to fabricating queries, including defect/rectification requirements.
  • Keep the lead engineer apprised of all activities and concerns (technical, budgetary, manpower).
  • Assist in providing inputs for planning and forecasting progress reports, including productivity metrics.
  • Participate in internal, customer, and third‑party technical audits of engineering deliverables.
  • Assist lead engineer with responses to customers and agencies on reviews and approvals.
  • Capture lessons learned and enter them into the MDR Lessons Learned system.
  • Act as a resource for less experienced colleagues and guide them on MDR and discipline procedures.
  • Be aware of costs related to own work and the discipline.
Design Environments
  • Pipeline installation discipline: review pipeline installation designs, analyses, and procedures for spools, PLETS and manifolds, and cables.
  • Structural installation discipline: review designs for loadout, transportation, and installation of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications.
  • Naval installation discipline: review naval architecture designs related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation.
Additional Preferred Skills
  • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures.

Essential Qualifications and Education
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master’s degree preferred).

description:
Technical Account Manager - Commerce / Partner Success (100% Remote - Brazil)

Join to apply for the Technical Account Manager - Commerce / Partner Success (100% Remote - Brazil) role at Hopper

Employment Modality (Brazil - EOR): This remote role will be classified as a long-term Employment Relationship (Relação de Emprego) under the Brazilian Consolidated Labor Laws (CLT). The contract will be managed through a local Employer of Record (EOR) to ensure full compliance with all Brazilian labor laws, including benefits, mandatory contributions, and tenure.

About The Job

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) powers the white-label travel platforms for some of the world’s largest financial institutions and airlines. As our strategic partner portfolio expands, so too does the need for sophisticated technical expertise and dedicated relationship management. We are seeking a high-impact Technical Account Manager (TAM) to be a technical liaison for multiple strategic partners. This critical role acts as the connective architect, seamlessly integrating Product, Engineering, Supply, and Customer Experience teams to ensure every partner receives clear, consistent, and exceptionally reliable support for technical inquiries and strategic growth initiatives. This is a hands‑on, results-oriented position. You will use your diagnostic skills and analytical abilities to validate incoming issues, structure comprehensive problem reports, and coordinate effectively with engineering. Your main goal is to ensure that all technical escalations are complete, actionable, and correctly prioritized. You will also play a key part in defining and optimizing our global intake, triage, communication, and escalation frameworks, helping partners get timely resolutions while keeping internal teams focused and efficient. In short, this role requires a blend of investigative curiosity, clear communication, strong organizational skills, and a process‑improvement mindset, applied across a dynamic portfolio of partners and parallel technical workstreams.

Partner Engagement & Communication
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for multiple B2B partners, each with unique needs, priorities, and communication channels.
  • Translate partner inquiries into structured, actionable requests with complete context.
  • Provide clear updates, timelines, and expectations, ensuring partners feel supported and aligned.
Technical Triage & Analysis
  • Assess and validate reported issues before escalating to engineering, including reproduction steps, logs, context, severity assessment, and relevant data insights.
  • Investigate technical or data-centric questions using internal tools, dashboards, and SQL; identify whether issues stem from configuration, supply content, product behavior, data quality, or true system defects.
  • Manage and prioritize requests across multiple partners simultaneously, balancing urgency, impact, and engineering bandwidth.
Process & Program Development
  • Improve intake workflows, templates, and triage mechanisms to create consistency across partners.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, supply, and Customer Experience teams to refine escalation paths, service expectations, and communication standards.
  • Contribute to playbooks, documentation, and partner-facing resources to strengthen transparency and scale operational excellence.
Cross‑Functional Collaboration
  • Coordinate with a wide and diverse set of stakeholders, including product managers, engineers, supply specialists, Customer Experience teams, and external partner teams.
  • Maintain clear follow-through, alignment, and ownership across parallel workstreams.
  • Advocate for partner needs while helping internal teams maintain focus and momentum.
An ideal candidate has
  • An excellent communicator who can build trust with partners and internal teams through clarity, consistency, and professionalism.
  • Comfortable operating across several partners at once, with strong prioritization, context-switching, and organizational skills.
  • Adept at turning ambiguity into clarity and designing repeatable processes that scale.
  • Technically fluent, with experience interpreting logs, analyzing data, exploring APIs, and using monitoring tools to support issue investigation and triage.
  • Experienced in roles such as Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Product Specialist, or a similar hybrid technical-customer role.
  • Strong judgment in evaluating issue severity, partner impact, and operational urgency.
Nice to Haves
  • Intermediate or advanced SQL skills; experience working with data analysis, BI tools, or large datasets (BigQuery experience is a plus).
  • Familiarity with API debugging, distributed systems, or SaaS platform operations.
  • Experience implementing or optimizing ticketing and triage systems (Zendesk, Jira Service Desk, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Background improving cross-functional workflows or partner-facing operations at scale.
Perks and benefits of working with us
  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers.
  • Very generous parental leave.
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.
More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Key Statistics
  • Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
  • Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.
  • Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6× more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
  • Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennial travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel eCommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen‑Z and Millennials.
